column1: table a7: reasons for not reporting incidents of crime to the police
England and Wales, year ending March 2025

This worksheet contains one table. The units in this table are responses in percentages of reasons for not reporting incidents of crime. Some cells refer to notes which can be found on the Notes worksheet.
Source: Crime Survey for England and Wales from the Office for National Statistics
Police would not have been bothered/interested
Reported to other authorities (e.g. superiors, company security)
Lack of trust in the police
Dislike or fear of the police/previous bad experience with the police or courts
Thought someone else had already reported incident/similar incidents
Tried to report, but unable to contact police/police not interested
